## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 13, 2026 - Sep 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _John Rinehart_, Sep 15, 2026, 3/5: "great tool for tracking your daily habits and is fairly accurate considering these kinds of apps are notoriously unreliable I've used it to go into a calorie deficit for fat loss and recently changed goals to maintenance as I learn things about my own metabolism. the suggested macros and caloric intake has been pretty good. however there are some basic functions that are behind a paywall, a paywall that didn't exist 4 yrs ago. greed doesn't look good on anyone."
            2. _Cari Cruse_, Sep 13, 2026, 3/5: "Feature Request: It would be so helpful when scrolling down our Diary if the calories (& macros) were pinned at the top. Also, please make the selected day more obvious at the top, it's too easy to enter things on the wrong day. || Cancelled Premium! New UI is horrible mess. Have used MFP 13 years."
            3. _Jason Ingraham_, Sep 16, 2026, 5/5: "canceled my trial subscription and they have tried charging my card 321 dollars. 4 times now."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Sep 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jonathan_, Sep 14, 2026, 1/5: "I used it before and worked great but now I can't log my foods. when I try to add anything just freezes. I've uninstall and reinstall many times but everytime it freezes."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
